_comment: Proposed content for game/data/regions.json, in the format design/regions.md decides. Kept in design/proto because no engine has seen it. Geometry is NOT here — a region's layout is a hand-authored build_region_<id>.gd, per that document. Only the look knobs design/hd2d_look.md permits may vary per region; the key light ANGLE is house style and is deliberately not expressible.

brief.ground: fired brick and ash, low warm light, everything slightly too orange
brief.work: people fired pots here; two of five kilns still run
brief.attention: it holds heat it no longer needs — things here sit on warmth and pretend it is coming back

brief.ground: bare rock, thin cold light, nothing between you and the sky
brief.work: the fastest way between two valleys, and nobody stops
brief.attention: it refuses to be arrived at — things here perform being out of reach

regions.quiet_note: An empty list is the point. narrative.md's escalation is a place doing less of what it does when watched, and a region's creatures ARE that — so a Ridge the practice has been through produces nothing to meet. No new content is needed to show it.

brief.ground: wet stone under a town that grew over it, lit by what falls through gratings
brief.work: it was foundations, then storage, then forgotten
brief.attention: it keeps holding up something that is no longer there
